verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API with API-key auth, published OpenAPI 3.1 specs, a Try-it playground, a versioning policy and an MCP server, but no item mentions an official client SDK in any language. A raw API and an OpenAPI spec are building blocks a developer could use to generate a client, not the official SDK the story asks for, and the MCP server is a separate capability, so none of these earn credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
